description: This file defines the exported API functions for the TLS Hso Client object, including creation, removal, registration, and initialization functions. It serves as an interface specification for external modules to interact with the TLS Hso Client component.

methods.name: TlsCreateHsoClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a new Hso Client object, initializing it with the provided context handles.

methods.name: TlsHsoClientCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the TLS Hso Client object with specified container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: TlsHsoClientRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the specified Hso Client object identified by the handle.

methods.name: TlsHsoClientEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers necessary internal objects within the Hso Client instance.

methods.name: TlsHsoClientInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Hso Client object, setting up default states and configurations.
